name: Sikaplan WP Trumpet Flange
paste:
SIKAPLAN® WP TRUMPET FLANGE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikaplan® WP Trumpet Flange, November 2020, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sikaplan-wp-trumpetflange.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikaplan® WP Trumpet Flange where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2020, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Sikaplan® WP Trumpet Flange is a preformed flange element with round base plate and pipe on base of PVC-p.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikaplan® WP Trumpet Flange is used as a sealing element for anchor penetrations through PVC membrane systems. Alternatively, the product can be used as injection flange for PVC membrane systems.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikaplan® WP Trumpet Flange
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Preformed sealing element for anchor penetrations
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Quality management system ISO 9001
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ISO 9001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compatible to all Sikaplan® WP membranes on base of PVC-p by heat welding
    - Flexible and versatile
    - For various anchor and rebar diameters
    - Easy and quick application
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: Trumpet-like preformed element with black colour
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Unit weight: 150 g/piece
    - Ambient maximum temperature of liquids: + 35 °C max. (service temperature)
2.7 System structure. Ancillary products for usage as sealing of anchor penetrations:
    - Sikaflex® PU sealant, for example Sikaflex® 11 FC
    - Jubilee clips to seal penetration
    - Hose nipple on base of metal or plastic, to be inserted into trumpet flange
    - Metal clamping ring to seal hose nipple
    - Injection hose, or metal pipe with inner winding
    Ancillary products for usage as injection flange:
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 40 pcs / cardboard box
    - Shelf life: 5 years shelf life from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging.
    - Storage conditions: Pieces must be stored in their original packaging and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (November 2020, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2020, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - For usage as sealing of anchor penetration
    - Installed Sikaplan® WP sheet membrane must be dry and clean. Installation according to valid Method Statement and standard detail drawing for basement and tunnel waterproofing with Sikaplan® WP sheet membranes. Cut a hole into and through the waterproofing system at rock bolt area. Clean the area to be welded (free from any dust, oil, grease, etc). Place and watertight weld the Sika trumpet flange to the tunnel waterproofing membrane. Tightly close the trumpet shaft around the rock anchor using Sikaflex® PU sealant and jubilee clips.
    - For usage as injection flange
    - Spotwise welding of base part on sheet membrane by heat welding tool, fixing of hose nipples into pipe by clamping with steel clamping ring. Fixed hose nipples to be connected with injection pipe.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations. This product must only be used by Sika approved applicators.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. + 5 °C min.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikaplan® WP Trumpet Flange, November 2020, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sikaplan-wp-trumpetflange.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
